ZinOwnershipAndTransfer.Purpose: Zin has no borrow checker, implicit reference counting, copy constructors, move constructors, destructors, or implicit cleanup. It provides only explicit compile-time copyability restrictions and explicit value transfer.

CopySemantics.Rule: Ordinary assignment, argument passing, return, tuple construction, and aggregate construction copy values when the source type is copyable.
Copying a pointer copies the address. Copying a slice copies only its pointer and length. Referenced storage is not copied.
There are no user-defined copy constructors.

NoCopyBuiltin.Rule: @nocopy is a compiler intrinsic type constructor and is never a keyword or declaration modifier.
NoCopyBuiltin.Representation: @nocopy never changes runtime size, alignment, field layout, enum backing representation, union representation, ABI representation, or emitted metadata of its wrapped type except compile-time type identity/copyability metadata.
NoCopyBuiltin.Propagation: An aggregate containing a non-copyable value by value is itself non-copyable. Pointers and slices referring to a non-copyable value remain copyable unless their own type is explicitly @nocopy.
NoCopyBuiltin.Restriction: A non-copyable value may not be copied through assignment, argument passing by value, tuple construction, return-by-value from a borrowed source, aggregate duplication, or implicit temporary duplication.

MoveBuiltin.Rule: @move evaluates its source expression exactly once.
The source must denote an addressable initialized value whose storage state can be tracked by semantic analysis.
@move transfers the value to the destination without invoking user code.
After the transfer the source storage state becomes Moved.
Reading, borrowing, passing, returning, field-accessing, dereferencing through, or moving a Moved source is a compile error.
Assigning a new fully initialized value to the complete source storage changes its state from Moved to Initialized.
@move performs no allocation, deallocation, destructor call, deinit call, copy constructor, move constructor, reference-count update, or hidden cleanup.
@move is permitted for copyable values but produces warning ZIN-W6001 RedundantMove unless required by generic code or explicitly suppressed.

LocalStateMachine.Rule: Semantic analysis tracks these states for local and temporary storage when required to enforce @nocopy and @move.

Moving an individual field may place an aggregate in PartiallyMoved state. Only still-initialized fields may subsequently be accessed. Copying or moving the whole aggregate is forbidden until all required fields are reinitialized.

NoImplicitDrop.Rule: Leaving scope never invokes a user function automatically.
Resource cleanup remains explicit through defer/errdefer and explicit deinit/close/free APIs.
